source_row.rationale: Standing orders are pre-established, provider-approved protocols (developed and periodically reviewed by the medical and nursing staff) that allow nurses to initiate specific interventions under clearly defined clinical circumstances, without requiring a new individual order for each instance — streamlining care for common, predictable clinical situations while maintaining appropriate oversight and defined parameters.
